description: As reported in the 2014 review, Bandyopadhyay’s group found resonance conductance through single microtubules at gigahertz, megahertz and kilohertz frequencies, with resistance dropping at specific frequencies largely independent of temperature and length.
limitations: Reported through the originators’ own review, not checked against the primary papers here.

sources.quote: where electrical resistance drops dramatically, at certain very specific frequencies, in a largely-temperature independent and length-independent way
